literal.prompt: Какой орган фильтрует кровь и помогает иммунитету бороться с микробами в ней?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The source says the spleen filters blood, removes microbes, and is a site of immune responses to blood-borne pathogens (L144); red pulp filters blood and white pulp mounts adaptive T/B responses (L149). The four choices are all organs; skin protection, heart pumping, and lung gas exchange are independently grounded at skin L32/L78-L79, heart L60/L92, and lungs L31/L42. These claims make spleen the unique key.
literalGroups.locator: Spleen L144-L149; skin L32/L78-L79; heart L60/L92; lungs L31/L42.

literalGroups.literal: Селезёнка фильтрует кровь: её клетки удаляют из неё микробы и погибающие эритроциты. В ней также разворачиваются иммунные ответы на патогены, попавшие в кровь.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Spleen macrophages and dendritic cells remove microbes and dying red blood cells from blood; immune responses to blood-borne pathogens occur there (L144). Red pulp filters blood and adaptive responses are mounted in white pulp (L149).

literalGroups.literal: Кожа образует защитный наружный покров организма.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Skin provides overall protection (L32); its superficial epidermis faces the outside environment and helps protect against microbial penetration (L78-L79).

literalGroups.literal: Сердце — полый мышечный орган, создающий движение крови.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The heart has four chambers (L60); the myocardium is cardiac muscle, and its contraction pumps blood through the heart into major arteries (L92).

literalGroups.literal: Лёгкие обеспечивают поступление кислорода в кровь и выведение углекислого газа.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The lungs exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide with atmospheric air (L31); erythrocytes pick up oxygen in the lung capillaries for transport to tissues (L42).

literalGroups.literal: Селезёнка удаляет из крови погибающие эритроциты.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The spleen removes dying red blood cells from blood (L144). This useful additional fact exceeds the prompt/key, which concern blood filtration and immune defense against microbes.

entries.correctNoteNewFact: The correct-option note adds that the spleen removes dying red blood cells from blood, beyond the prompt/key about filtration and immune defense against microbes; OpenStax 21.1 L144.
entries.absoluteDifficulty: Frozen EASY is defensible with plain language: a single-step recognition of the spleen as a blood-filtering immune organ, without specialized antigen terminology or multistep reasoning. All four options are ordinary organs and are plausible through their basic roles in protection, blood circulation, or gas exchange.
